title: Optical Imaging Scans for the Diagnosis of Skin Cancer in Patients With Lesions
official: Assessment of Novel Label-free Optical Imaging Technology for the Evaluation of Skin Lesions
summary: This clinical trial studies how well an optical imaging scan called quantitative oblique back-illumination microscopy (qOBM) helps in diagnosing skin cancer in patients with skin lesions. qOBM is a non-invasive procedure that uses red light for illumination, and may work better than no imaging procedures in aiding doctors in diagnosing skin lesions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or Female
* Candidate with skin lesions
* Signed study-specific informed consent prior to study entry
* ≥ 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior surgery or radiotherapy to the area to be treated
